name: Document360
description: Knowledge workspaces, articles, categories, API references, Drive assets, readers, teams, translations, workflows, languages, and project settings through Customer API v2.
agentUseSummary: Enter a customer-owned project API token once, then let agents use the complete token-authorized Customer API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: DOCUMENT360_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Document360 API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated project token and select the intended GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods.

credentialRequirements.name: DOCUMENT360_API_ORIGIN
credentialRequirements.label: Document360 API origin
credentialRequirements.helpText: Optional official US or private-hosting API Hub origin; defaults to https://apihub.document360.io.

capabilities.label: Read knowledge
capabilities.description: Discover workspaces and read bounded article metadata and content.

capabilities.label: Create and maintain knowledge
capabilities.description: Create, update, publish, translate, import, export, organize, and delete token-authorized knowledge.

capabilities.label: Manage project resources
capabilities.description: Manage API references, Drive, readers, teams, groups, roles, workflows, languages, and custom fields permitted by the token.

allowed.label: List articles
allowed.description: List one bounded page of workspace articles.

allowed.label: Read article
allowed.description: Read one article translation without SAS-token expansion.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Customer API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Customer API v2 operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded workspace and article reads run directly; every other Customer API call requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token-authorized Document360 operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, official origin, token method permissions, bounds, audits, redaction, and provider limits still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Document360 project API token or signed-in portal session was available.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer creates a dedicated token with intended HTTP methods, enters it and the official API Hub origin, then Relay runs health, bounded reads, Safe denial plus approval, and Dangerous-mode mutation.

evidence.supports: Document360 Customer API 2.0.0 is project-scoped, token-authenticated, revocable, and manages knowledge, permissions, users, and settings.
Customers create API tokens and explicitly select allowed GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods; tokens are secrets and all traffic is HTTPS.

The official OpenAPI 2.0.0 specification currently publishes 88 v2 paths across articles, categories, API references, Drive, project import/export, workspaces, readers, teams, translations, languages, and fields, plus global, US, and private-hosting API Hub origins.
GET /v2/ProjectVersions is the primary idempotent discovery endpoint and returns workspace IDs used by other endpoints.
Document360 publishes rate-limit response and Retry-After semantics for Customer API operations.
